user.title: Eufy NVR (local)
user.description: Point this at the go2rtc instance run by the Eufy NVR add-on or bridge. Use the same local username and password configured in the add-on. Cameras are discovered automatically from its eufy_* streams.

data_description.host: IP or hostname of the machine running the bridge/add-on. For the add-on, use the Home Assistant host's LAN address.
data_description.api_port: Dedicated Eufy go2rtc API / web UI port (default 1985), used to auto-discover cameras.
data_description.rtsp_port: Dedicated Eufy go2rtc RTSP port (default 8556), used to stream each camera.
data_description.username: Must match go2rtc_username in the Eufy NVR add-on.
data_description.password: Must match go2rtc_password in the Eufy NVR add-on (minimum 16 characters).

reconfigure.title: Eufy NVR (local)
reconfigure.description: Update where go2rtc is reachable. Cameras re-discover automatically after saving.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach go2rtc at that host/port. Check that the Eufy NVR add-on or bridge is running and the go2rtc API port is correct.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid hostname or IP address, with API and RTSP ports in their separate fields.
error.wrong_instance: That address is another go2rtc instance containing non-Eufy streams—usually Home Assistant's built-in server on port 1984. Use the Eufy add-on API port 1985.
error.no_streams: go2rtc is reachable, but it has not published any eufy_* cameras. Finish add-on discovery or check its log, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This go2rtc endpoint is already configured.
